approval_notes: Orchestrator-directed F006 Slice 2 (the Catalogue WEB experience: provider-agnostic browse / search / filter / category-matrix / compare UI). Build ONE slice, open ONE PR, do NOT merge, do NOT flip any passes flag. F006 stays passes:false.

Grows apps/web (React 19 + Vite + Vitest) from the single Cloudflare provider page into a provider-agnostic catalogue browser that consumes ONLY the F006 Slice 1 + existing read-only /api/catalogue/* GET endpoints over the same-origin nginx /api proxy. No backend change, no new endpoint, no DB access, no migration (Alembic head stays 0007), no new npm/Python dependency (Q8).

Owner decisions binding this slice: Q6 provider-agnostic (the UI must render multiple providers; only Cloudflare is really published, so multi-provider rendering is proven with MOCKED synthetic-provider fetch responses in tests and never emits a false real-world free claim on the live stack); Q8 no new dependency (use React 19 + existing Vitest/Testing-Library; use fireEvent for interaction since user-event is not a dependency). Honest 'Unknown' for null fields; confidence LABEL primary with any numeric only inside a closed advanced/<details> region; the UI never re-derives Z0/confidence (display only what the API says).

Standing autonomy boundaries: may branch/implement/test/commit/push/open ONE PR; may NOT merge, flip any passes flag, add a dependency, add a migration, add a backend endpoint or mutation, access the DB directly, introduce a user-controlled URL / SSRF surface, or re-derive Z0/confidence in the UI.
objective: Grow the public web app (apps/web) into a provider-agnostic catalogue browser built entirely on the read-only /api/catalogue/* GET surface: (a) a SEARCH box (keyword q) and composable FILTER controls (provider, category, zero_cost_class, offer_type, commercial_use, status) driving GET /catalogue/search with stable pagination; (b) a RESULTS list rendering each published offer's provider/service/category, Z0 class as a colour+text+icon badge, and plain-language confidence label; (c) a CATEGORY MATRIX view rendering GET /catalogue/categories as an accessible coverage table (all 14 canonical categories x provider coverage states + honest per-provider uncategorized rollup); (d) a COMPARE view where the user picks 2-3 offers and sees a normalized side-by-side from GET /catalogue/compare (Z0 class, normalized quotas with honest 'unknown' fail-closed, requires_card/paid deps, commercial/personal use, confidence LABEL primary, completeness/freshness, evidence linkage). Landing + routing live in App.tsx. All values the API returns as null are shown honestly as 'Unknown'.
scope: apps/web/src/api.ts: add typed GET fetchers fetchSearch (composable params -> /catalogue/search), fetchCategoryMatrix (-> /catalogue/categories), fetchCompare (offer id list -> /catalogue/compare?offers=...), and fetchProviders (-> /catalogue/providers, for the provider filter option list). Add the matching response interfaces (SearchResultItem/SearchFilters/SearchResponse, ProviderCoverage/CategoryMatrixRow/UncategorizedCoverage/CategoryMatrixResponse, NormalizedQuota/CompareOffer/CompareResponse) mirroring apps/api/app/read_api/schemas.py exactly. Every path stays a fixed same-origin /api path built only from internal slugs/ids/enums (query values are validated against closed sets client-side); no URL/host is ever accepted and fetched (no SSRF).

apps/web/src/catalogue/vocab.ts (new): plain-language option lists + labels for the filter enums (zero_cost_class, offer_type, offer status, commercial_use tri-state) drawn from the API's closed vocabularies, reused by Filters and by the results/compare formatting. No behaviour is derived here beyond display labels.

apps/web/src/catalogue/SearchControls.tsx (new): the search box + filter controls as an accessible <form> (associated <label>s, keyboard-operable native <select>/<input>, a submit button). Emits a typed query object; never builds a URL.

apps/web/src/catalogue/ResultsList.tsx (new): the paged results list (semantic list, per-result Z0 badge + confidence label + provider/service/category, honest 'Unknown'), stable pagination controls (prev/next + page-of-total), an honest empty state, and a keyboard-operable compare-select control that adds/removes an offer from the compare selection.

apps/web/src/catalogue/CategoryMatrix.tsx (new): the 14-category x provider coverage matrix as an accessible <table> (caption + column/row <th scope>), each coverage cell a colour+visible-text+aria-hidden-icon badge (never colour-only), plus the honest per-provider uncategorized rollup. Renders every canonical category even when empty.

apps/web/src/catalogue/CompareView.tsx (new): the side-by-side comparison of the selected 2-3 offers from /catalogue/compare, as an accessible <table> (caption + th scope) with a column per offer; rows for Z0 class, normalized quotas (honest 'Unknown' when the API reports it could not normalize), requires_card/paid deps/commercial/personal use, confidence LABEL primary with numeric only inside a closed advanced <details>, completeness/freshness, and an evidence-count linkage.

apps/web/src/App.tsx + App.css: hash-based landing/routing (no new dependency) across a Browse view (SearchControls + ResultsList), a Categories view (CategoryMatrix), a Compare view (CompareView over the current selection), and the retained single-provider Cloudflare page. A single top-level <h1>, ordered headings, semantic landmarks (nav/main/contentinfo), and keyboard-operable navigation.

apps/web/src/catalogue/*.test.tsx + apps/web/src/api.test.ts + apps/web/src/App.test.tsx: Vitest + Testing-Library tests (offline, mocked fetch, fireEvent) proving: the api client builds fixed /api paths with correctly encoded/validated params; search + each filter + composed filters + pagination render REAL (mocked) API JSON; MULTI-PROVIDER rendering via synthetic providers in the mocked search + matrix + compare responses; the category matrix always shows all 14 categories + coverage states + uncategorized rollup; compare renders normalized quotas and fails closed to 'Unknown'; confidence LABEL is primary and the numeric is only inside a closed <details>; honest 'Unknown' for null fields; and the a11y measures (single h1, ordered headings, landmarks, table caption + th scope, keyboard-operable controls + details, external links rel=noopener noreferrer, every badge pairs colour + visible text + aria-hidden icon).

apps/web/src/catalogue/testFixtures.ts: add offline synthetic multi-provider fixtures + mocked-fetch routing for the new search/categories/compare endpoints (clearly synthetic 'example-*' providers, used only by tests, never published on a normal stack run).

apps/web/README.md + docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: document the new catalogue browser (routes, the read-only /api seam, provider-agnostic browse/search/filter/matrix/compare, a11y posture). Append an agent-state/progress.md handoff.
out_of_scope: The architecture adviser / 'chat with your data' / any LLM path (later F006 slices).
Any backend change: no new/changed API endpoint, no change to search/categories/compare semantics, no migration (Alembic head stays 0007), no DB access from the web app.

Any new Python or npm runtime/dev dependency (npm audit + requirements-sync + pip-audit stay green; React 19 + already-present Vitest/Testing-Library only). If a hard blocker requires one, STOP and report.
Any write/mutation from the UI; any user-controlled URL / fetchable host (no SSRF surface).
Re-deriving or upgrading Z0 class or confidence in the UI (display only what the API returns).
Exposing community / discovery_candidate data (the read API never returns it; the UI never asks for it).
Flipping F006 passes:true or editing any feature_list.json passes flag.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A user can search, apply and COMPOSE filters (provider, category, zero_cost_class, offer_type, commercial_use, status), page through results, browse the 14-category coverage matrix, and compare 2-3 offers side-by-side, end-to-end against REAL published data on the live stack through the /api proxy.
2. Every view renders REAL data returned by /api (verified against the actual endpoint JSON, not hard-coded), and honestly shows 'Unknown' for any null field.

3. Accessibility is asserted by tests: a single top-level h1, ordered headings, semantic landmarks; the category-matrix and compare tables use a caption + th scope; all controls and <details> are keyboard operable; external links carry rel=noopener noreferrer; every badge pairs colour + visible text + an aria-hidden icon (never colour-only).
4. Confidence is LABEL-primary everywhere; any numeric score appears only inside a closed advanced/<details> region; the UI never re-derives Z0 class or confidence.

5. No user-controlled URL and no SSRF: every request is a fixed same-origin /api/catalogue/* GET whose params are internal slugs/ids/enums validated against closed sets; the web app never touches the DB and never mutates.

6. Provider-agnostic behaviour is proven via MOCKED multi-provider fetch responses in tests (search across >1 provider, the matrix across providers, compare across providers); the live stack only ever shows real published (Cloudflare) data and never emits a false real-world free claim.
7. No new dependency and no backend/migration change: Alembic head stays 0007; requirements-sync + npm audit stay green.

8. Offline regression green: scripts/test.ps1 (pytest + web vitest + web build) exits 0 and scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit (all 8 gates: ruff lint, ruff format, pytest, prettier, eslint, detect-secrets, pip-audit, npm audit) exits 0.
9. F006 remains passes:false; a fresh-context independent Level 2 evaluator owns any status change.

integration_commands: Fresh live stack on alternate host ports (POSTGRES_PORT=55432, API_PORT=8010, WEB_PORT=8090, DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://atlas:atlas@localhost:55432/atlas): docker compose down --volumes -> scripts/stack-up.ps1 --build (fresh DB applies 0001-0007) -> python -m app.ingest.runner --publish (seed published Cloudflare data) -> scripts/stack-smoke.ps1 -> over WEB_PORT=8090 confirm the served bundle renders the catalogue UI and that search / filter / category-matrix / compare all pull REAL data through the nginx /api proxy (a headless/jsdom render of the real App against the live proxy is the established proof pattern) -> docker compose down --volumes. Delete scratch files; leave git status clean.

risks.data_migration: None: web-only slice. No migration. Alembic head stays 0007. No DB access from the web app.
risks.security_privacy: The web app issues only fixed same-origin /api/catalogue/* GET requests. Search q is passed as a bounded query-string value (encoded, never as a URL/host and never fetched); provider/category are slugs and enum filters are validated against closed client-side sets mirroring the API. No user-controlled URL / no SSRF. Community/discovery_candidate data is never requested and never returned by the read API.
risks.portability: No new runtime/dev dependency; hash-based routing uses the platform History/Location API; reuses React 19 + Vite + Vitest already present. amd64/arm64 unaffected.
risks.zero_cost_safety: The UI surfaces the Z0 class, reasons, and confidence exactly as the API returns them; it never re-derives or upgrades a class. Normalized quotas are shown as the API reports them, honestly 'Unknown' when the API says it could not normalize. Multi-provider rendering is proven with clearly-synthetic fixtures that are never published on a normal stack run, so no false real-world free claim is ever emitted.
risks.immutability: Read-only slice: the web app performs no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and never touches the DB. Backend triggers and immutability are untouched.
risks.regression: Additive: new api-client fetchers + new components + hash routing. The existing Cloudflare provider page, api client fetchers, and all existing tests are preserved. No backend behaviour changes.
risks.supply_chain: No new Python or npm dependency; requirements-sync + pip-audit + npm audit stay green; React 19 + already-present dev deps only.
